# Proceed <img class="product" src="media/bp-20x14.png" alt="BlitzPlus" title="BlitzPlus" width="20" height="14">

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzPlus](BlitzPlus) · [System](BlitzPlus-System)

</div>


```blitzbasic
Proceed:Int32 text:String, serious:Int32=0
```

| Parameter | Mode | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | In | String | required | The question. |
| `serious` | In | Int32 | `0` | 1 for the warning symbol, 0 for information. Defaults to 0. |

**Returns:** 1 for Yes, 0 for No and -1 for Cancel.

## Description

Shows a question with Yes, No and Cancel and waits for the answer. Lines can be split with `Chr$(13)`.

## Differences

* The box is a message box of the operating system in front of the program's active window. Without a screen it writes the text to the error output and answers -1.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 32, 2
Select Proceed("Save before quitting?")
	Case 1  Notify "Saved"
	Case 0  Notify "Dropped"
	Case -1 Notify "Staying"
End Select
```
